notes: Inline batch-split fix for The Library. Removes the v1.0.6 separate-window batch workflow and replaces it with ADD MULTIPLE FULL WRAPS inside the existing Split tab. Each selected wrap gets its own full splitter block on the same tab with independent spine guides and its own Title/Book, Ship, Fandom, Extra Tags, and Cover Type fields. Each cover has SAVE THIS COVER TO LIBRARY, which splits that one wrap into Back Cover, Spine, and Front Cover and saves those pieces directly into The Library using the existing Library record/storage path. Covers can be saved one at a time in any order; there is no requirement to finish or export the whole batch first, no Downloads/folder-export step, and no Apply to All control. Windows PowerShell parsing, synthetic v1.0.6-to-v1.0.7 patching, payload validation, and all internal SHA-256 checks passed before publish.
